## How to use this skill

1. Read the page as it is today; don't work from memory. From the repository root:
   `python3 .claude/skills/hig/scripts/hig_page.py edit-menus`
   For one section: `python3 .claude/skills/hig/scripts/hig_page.py edit-menus --section <anchor>`, with an anchor from the list below.
